intent_summary: Residual rules identify location shifts, trends, oscillation, mixture patterns, and short-term variation beyond isolated point departures.

criteria.criterion: Nelson location rules and CUSUM can identify a sustained residual location shift without any point-threshold crossing.
criteria.notes: Tests assert no point triggers or episodes and exact upward/downward detection positions for Nelson rules and CUSUM.

criteria.criterion: CUSUM reports the first detection position, direction, accumulated score, and configured threshold.
criteria.notes: The known accumulation detects at index 16 and reports peak CUSUM approximately 6, threshold 5, and increase direction.

criteria.criterion: Trend, oscillation, and mixture findings retain their specific pattern meanings.
criteria.notes: Separate predicates and descriptions preserve the three meanings and explicitly limit location/distribution claims.

criteria.criterion: Moving-range findings identify variation changes separately from location changes.
criteria.notes: Adjacent standardized-residual differences produce variation_shift findings; the test checks magnitude, detection index, and interpretation.
